plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Flight Technology Certificate (Fall Start)' program map, Catalog 2025-26, published July 19, 2025 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/6827/PublishedPdf). Start Term: Fall. Official Total Units: 31 = 4+12+15, verified against the map's 4 / 12 / 15 headers. This is a Certificate of Achievement (no GE pattern; all courses are major core). The map's 'First Year'/'Second Year' headings are retained in the three numbered semesters as printed. In-plan prereqs sequenced (all with grades of C or better): FLTEC 302, 304, 306, 330 each require FLTEC 320; FLTEC 310 and FLTEC 321 require FLTEC 302, 304, 306, 330; FLTEC 314 requires FLTEC 302, 304, 306, 310, 330; FLTEC 312 requires FLTEC 302, 304, 306, 310, 320. The map's alternative FAA-credential paths (FAA Private Pilot Certificate, FAA Private Pilot Knowledge exam, or higher FAA Pilot Certificate) are documented in choice notes but the modeled path uses the in-plan course sequence. Certificates of Achievement require a grade of C or better in each major course (map note). tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
